description: Lists your measurements with commands adapted to each saved device environment. Two views of the same thing: `coletas` is one entry per measurement, `equipamentos` is one per machine with a SINGLE command that does all of its measurements and a SINGLE cron line. Use the device one unless you really want a single measurement on its own. Commands are generated only from a detected environment. Legacy collections without one keep their readings, but comandos.agora/agenda are null until a compatible environment is provided. Curl, wget and Python 3 follow the detected capabilities; Windows disk uses PowerShell. comandos.agora is a readable multiline block; run the whole block together. A separate cron line is offered only when crontab exists. Unsupported formats are never guessed.
name: list_collections
title: List collections
